main_body: A wooden slatted crate or rack seen from the front, with a thick snow layer on top and dark posts at the sides
top_band: Snow in white and pale blue (L 249/228/200/166), rows 1-7, ending in a blue shadow row at row 8 and icicles
evidence: In column x=16 the snow rows 1-7 (L 166-249) are clearly lighter than the wood front below (L 176 tan with L 37-45 dark slat gaps). A blue shadow row at row 8 (L 130) and icicles mark the front edge and eave. The slats and frame are inset, with dark gaps and posts. The 7-row snow cap is a real horizontal surface and the front is 15 rows, so it reads as 3/4. The object is a wooden crate with snow, not an organic plant or rock, so the kind label does not match.

style.evidence: The snow ramp has about 5 lightness steps (white, pale blue, mid blue, shadow blue) with a clumpy edge and icicles. The wood has fewer steps (tan, dark brown, grey-brown) but carries slat detail. Median colours per tile is 20, equal to the well reference, and flat-fill coverage is 0%. Only 19% of dark edge pixels are neutral, so the outlines are mostly tinted brown or blue. Total distinct colours (23) is lower than the references (38-40), but per-tile density matches, so it would sit acceptably next to them.
